```{=html}
<div class="cg-wrap">
  <iframe class="cg-frame"
          src="/the-calendar-layers.html"
          title="The Calendar, All At Once — 44 stacked ASCII galaxies on different clocks"
          loading="lazy"></iframe>
</div>

<style>
  .cg-wrap {
    position: relative;
    width: 100%;
    height: calc(100vh - 56px);
    background: #03040a;
    overflow: hidden;
    /* Contain the iframe's painting/compositing to this box so its heavy
       animation cannot trigger repaints of the navbar or footer. */
    isolation: isolate;
    contain: paint;
    transform: translateZ(0);
  }
  .cg-frame {
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    border: 0;
    display: block;
  }
  @media (max-width: 768px) {
    .cg-wrap { height: calc(100vh - 48px); }
  }
</style>
```
